name: plan_shape
description: Plan-shape generator (平面形状): emits each storey's wall OUTLINE (单层周界格) as a marker layer for the build AI to raise walls from — fixes the 'all plans are rectangles' failure. Shapes: rect / L / T / U (主体+翼楼矩形拼合, wing size preset + side from seed) / rect_bump (矩形带凹凸, notches until concavity hits the calibrated tier: footprint<=238 cells -> 0.10~0.28, larger -> 0.17~0.43; GrabCraft 299-plan stats, scratch/phase9/gc_probe/stats_details.md 二b). All orientation script-derived (禁止手改方向状态).
when_to_use: Any house/hall plan before raising walls; pick shape by体量与风格 (L=农舍/庄园, T=对称宅邸, U=内院, rect_bump=大体量自然凹凸). origin = 平面包围盒西北角格, y = 一层墙基层. 上层周界悬空是平面标记不是结构, support_check 不适用. 每层周界同形, 层距 +4 (3墙+1楼板); 收分/jetty 用别的卡.

origin.notes: 包围盒西北角格(正面左后角); y=一层墙基层

facing.notes: 正面朝向; 平面随其整体旋转

shape.notes: 平面形式; L/T/U=主体+翼楼拼合

wing.notes: 翼楼尺寸档=占比0.25/0.35/0.45; 仅 L/T/U 用

storeys.notes: 层数; 每层输出一条周界

material.notes: 轮廓标记材(无方向整方块); 起墙时按风格卡替换

seed.notes: 翼楼侧向/凹凸位置目标的随机源; 同参同输出

pitfalls: 翼楼朝向/侧向由 seed 推导演出 — 想换侧向改 seed, 禁止手摆输出格
rect_bump 的凹凸率分档按 stats: 小体量(<=238格)0.10~0.28, 大体量0.17~0.43; 别手动超 0.43, 那是废墟不是民居
轮廓材只是标记 — 起墙必须按风格卡换成真实墙材, 别把 stone_bricks 标记当墙留下
width/depth <5 拼不出翼楼; 要更小体量直接用 rect
example: python patterns/plan_shape.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"shape":"L","width":11,"depth":9,"wing":"medium","seed":5}' --out planL.json && python patterns/plan_shape.py --params '{"origin":[140,64,100],"shape":"rect_bump","width":13,"depth":11,"storeys":2,"seed":9}' --out planB.json
